senses.gloss:
† नड् नड्, i. 10, Par. To fall.
 --Cf. नट्.

नड नड, probably a form of नर्त, m. (and n.), Reed.
 --Cf. नल.
नड्वल नड्वल, i. e. नड + वल, n. A reed-bed, MBh. 5, 707.

नाडिका नाडिका, i. e. नाडी + क, f.
 1. A measure of time, (1/60) of a sidereal day, an Indian hour, Bhāg. P. 3, 11, 3.
 2. A measure of length, half a daṇḍa, Mārk. P. 49, 39.
 3. An Indian clock, Kām. Nītis. 5, 51.
नाडी नाडी, i. e. नड + अ + ई, also

नाडि नाडि (Bhāg. P. 3, 5, 11), f.
 1. The stalk or culm of any plant.
 2. Any tubular organ of the body, as an artery, a vein, an intestine, etc., MBh. 3, 13974; Ragh. 10, 59 (the rays of the sun, supposed to be hollow).
 3. A fistulous sore, Suśr. 1, 284, 11.
 4. = नाडिका 1, Sūryas. 1, 12.
 --Comp.
नाडी- + यन्त्र नाडी- + यन्त्र, n. any tubelike apparatus, Suśr. 1, 23, 17.
